description.zh: 说清影响面、当前进展和 ETA
description.en: Communicate impact, status, and ETA under pressure

zh: 给 ETA 或下次更新

line.text: We're getting error spikes in eu-west. What do you know so far?
line.translation: eu-west 这边错误在飙升。你目前了解到什么？

next_lines.text: We're seeing 500s in eu-west after the last deploy.
next_lines.translation: 上次发布后，eu-west 开始出现 500 错误。

next_lines.text: Impact is limited to checkout requests so far.
next_lines.translation: 目前影响范围只涉及结账请求。

line.text: Status check — eu-west is degrading. Give me what you have.
line.translation: 报一下状态——eu-west 在恶化，把你手上的信息给我。

next_lines.text: The error rate is still climbing; rollback is in progress.
next_lines.translation: 错误率还在升高，回滚正在进行。

next_lines.text: I'll confirm customer impact and share an update in five minutes.
next_lines.translation: 我会确认客户影响，五分钟后同步。

line.text: How bad is it? Customers are asking about the eu-west errors.
line.translation: 有多严重？客户在问 eu-west 的错误。

next_lines.text: About 2% of requests are failing; core checkout is affected.
next_lines.translation: 大约 2% 的请求失败，核心结账流程受影响。

next_lines.text: No data loss so far, and we're rolling back the change.
next_lines.translation: 目前没有数据丢失，我们正在回滚这次变更。

guidance: 语速可以偏快、追问频繁，模拟真实故障沟通压力。用户含糊时追问                    "What's the customer impact?" 或 "When will we have an update?"。
